title: Ferguson to Acquire FloWorks for $1.6 Billion, Increasing its Total Addressable Market to $400 Billion and Expanding its Non-Residential Value-Added Capabilities
summary: Strategic acquisition expected to: Add technical talent and broaden capabilities in valves, valve automation, specialty flow control solutions and service and repair offerings Meaningfully increase exposure to growth markets with secular tailwinds including datacenters, semiconductors, power generation and pharmaceuticals Drive significant revenue synergies across multiple non-residential customer groups including Industrial, Commercial Mechanical and Waterworks Be immediately accretive to Adjusted EPS1 Ferguson Enterprises Inc. (NYSE: FERG; LSE: FERG) announced today it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire FWI Holdings, Inc. (“FloWorks”), a leading industrial distributor and service provider of highly technical valves and flow control solutions, from Wynnchurch Capital L.P.
